description: Collage of three screenshots concerning Erik Prince. Top left: a Breitbart News Daily article excerpt claiming Blackwater founder Erik Prince said an NYPD source told him the NYPD wanted a press conference on warrants/arrests in the Anthony Weiner investigation but got 'huge pushback' from the Justice Department. Right: two Q posts of Apr 8 2018 with highlighted lines ('Who/what is not pictured?', 'Think Double') and a Politico link calling Erik Prince a CIA asset. Bottom: a Nov 24 2017 anon post ('Betsy DeVos > Erik Prince > POTUS') with a Q reply 'Who knows where the bodies are buried?'. Red circles and yellow highlights annotate the claimed connections.
text: Blackwater founder and former Navy SEAL Erik Prince told Breitbart News Daily on SiriusXM that according to one of his "well-placed sources" in the New York Police Department, "The NYPD wanted to do a press conference announcing the warrants and the additional arrests they were making" in the Anthony Weiner investigation, but received "huge pushback" from the Justice Department. description: Screenshot of a Donald J. Trump (@realDonaldTrump) tweet dated 2 May 2018 attacking a 'Rigged System' over document redactions and hinting he may 'use the powers granted to the Presidency and get involved'.

description: Screenshot of a satirical tweet from a parody account styled as Secretary of State Mike Pompeo but named 'Mike Pampeo' (@SecOfState70), joking about naming a spying operation after Rolling Stones lyrics, dated 5/17/18. The avatar is a photo of the real Mike Pompeo.
text: Mike Pampeo @SecOfState70. Currently scrolling through Rolling Stones lyrics to name our next spying op. Any requests? 5/17/18, 10:28 AM.
flags: Parody account — 'Mike Pampeo' @SecOfState70 is not the real Mike Pompeo; the tweet is satire, not an official statement.

description: Photograph, letterboxed with black bars (phone-screenshot format), of a warehouse interior with large cardboard cartons banded in yellow tape stacked on wooden pallets, plus one plywood shipping crate with metal edging at right. One carton is marked with dimensions '960*960*935' and carries small shipping labels, one orange. Nothing in the image identifies the location, contents, or owner. Filename in the post was 'Clas_1.png'.
flags: Location, contents, and significance of the boxes cannot be determined from the image; shipping labels are too small to read.

description: Night photograph, letterboxed in phone-screenshot format, taken from an elevated position looking down on an ornate, floodlit Victorian-style corner building with a mansard roof, tree-lined street, queued traffic with red tail lights, and pedestrians. The building and setting are consistent with the Corinthia Hotel London seen from across Northumberland Avenue/Victoria Embankment Gardens. The original filename 'NSA_Traf_CAM_ROT3.png' implies the image is an NSA traffic-camera capture, which cannot be verified from the image itself.
flags: Building identification as the Corinthia Hotel London is probable, not certain; the filename's NSA traffic-camera claim is unverified.

description: Screenshot of a 4chan post by Q (tripcode !ITPb.qbhqo, 11/09/17, No.148782302) attaching a file named '_AF1_5A_2.png', shown with its thumbnail and the full image below: a photograph taken through an aircraft window at altitude over ocean, with layered clouds, sunset light, and several small islands visible below. The filename implies it was taken aboard Air Force One during Trump's November 2017 Asia trip; the location is not identifiable from the image.
flags: The claim that the photo was taken from Air Force One rests only on the filename and Q context; the aircraft and location cannot be verified from the image.

description: Screenshot of image 11 of 12 in a Straits Times photo gallery: silhouetted security personnel on the illuminated stepped deck of the Sands SkyPark atop Marina Bay Sands, Singapore, at night on June 11 2018, with the lit city skyline behind. The caption notes North Korean leader Kim Jong Un was expected to visit the SkyPark ahead of the Trump-Kim summit.
text: 11 of 12. Security personnel at Sands SkyPark on June 11, 2018, where North Korean leader Kim Jong Un is expected to visit. ST PHOTO: LINETTE LAI.
people: Kim Jong Un (named in caption, not pictured)
flags: Security personnel are unidentified private individuals; Kim Jong Un appears only in the caption's claim of an expected visit.

description: Screenshot of a verified Donald J. Trump (@realDonaldTrump) tweet dated 6/11/18, defending the upcoming Singapore summit with North Korea: he says hostages are back and missile launches have stopped, dismissing 'haters & losers' and pundits. Contains the original misspellings 'missle' and 'stoped'.
text: Donald J. Trump @realDonaldTrump. The fact that I am having a meeting is a major loss for the U.S., say the haters & losers. We have our hostages, testing, research and all missle launches have stoped, and these pundits, who have called me wrong from the beginning, have nothing else they can say! We will be fine! 6/11/18, 6:04 PM.

description: Photograph, letterboxed in phone-screenshot format, of a Google campus bicycle — the distinctive Google-colored cruiser bike (yellow frame with 'Google' logo, red seat and basket, green fenders, blue and red accents) — standing beside a row of empty red bike racks on a sunny landscaped sidewalk. A truck trailer with a partially visible 1-800 number passes on the road behind. Setting is consistent with the Google campus in Mountain View, California, though no signage confirms the exact location.
flags: Exact location inferred from the Google campus bike and setting, not shown by signage; truck lettering only partially legible.
